// Edit asset-world-template/battle_conf.txt or the world env file, then re-render.
//
// --- World ${WORLD} battle settings ---
//
// Overrides conf/battle/*.conf for THIS world only (imported last, via
// conf/battle_athena.conf -> conf/import/battle_conf.txt). Intentionally empty:
// every world currently runs stock rates.
//
// Per-world rates are the usual reason to fill this in, e.g.:
//
//   base_exp_rate: 100
//   job_exp_rate: 100
//   item_rate_common: 100
//   item_rate_equip: 100
//   item_rate_mvp: 100
//
// Hardcoding them here applies them to every world, since all worlds render
// from this one template. To vary them per world, add the variable to
// .env.world-<id>, list it in the TOKENS array in render-assets.sh, and
// reference it here in dollar-brace form. A placeholder left unresolved aborts
// the render, so a token added here without a matching env entry fails loudly
// instead of silently emitting an empty value.
//
// NOTE: this comment cannot itself show a dollar-brace example — render-assets.sh
// greps the output for leftover placeholders and would abort on it.
